test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What will be the compound interest (in Rs., to the nearest rupee) on Rs. 17,600 for 2 years at 7% per annum, compounded annually?
solution:
Formula:

A = P × (1 + Rover 100)T

CI = A - P

where-

P = Principal

R = Rate

T = Time

CI = Compound Interest

A = Amount

Calculated:

Amount = Rs 17,600 × (1 + 7over 100)2

Amount = Rs 17,600 × 107over100 × 107over100 = Rs 20,150

CI = Rs 20,150 - Rs 17,600 = Rs 2550

∴ The CI is Rs 2550.
